changes.update: When a new version is out, a window tells you what it brings and you install it with one button or leave it for later.
changes.both: The PC and the phone remind you to update the other one, since they work best on the same version.

builtWith: Made with Rust, Tauri and Svelte. The in-game overlay is native: no browser, almost no memory.
available: A new version is out: v{{version}}.
installHint: Xyra closes and opens the installer; your settings and games are kept.
dialogVersions: You have v{{current}}. The new one brings:
dialogPhone: If you use the phone app, update it too: the PC and the phone work best on the same version. The app offers it when you open it.
